📚 Hard vocab word #45: MERCURIAL

mercurial (adjective): subject to sudden, unpredictable changes of mood.

✅ In a sentence: The mercurial star was cheerful one minute and furious the next.
✅ Similar: volatile, capricious, temperamental
✅ Remember it: Like mercury (quicksilver): it won't stay still.
